name: GAN i Carry 4 3x3 (Magnetic, UV Coated) - SSL Limited, Bluetooth Smart Cube
description: The GAN i Carry 4 3x3 (Magnetic, UV Coated) - SSL Limited, Bluetooth Smart Cube is a beginner-friendly smart speed cube that blends app-powered training with a more premium in-hand feel.
features: Learn faster with the app: Beginner course content, master classes, and expert mentoring help make improvement more structured.
Practice with real feedback: Solve playback and turning data help you see where you are improving and what to clean up next.
More premium presentation: The UV-coated exterior and transparent blue internals give this version a more polished, special-edition look.
Reliable smart tracking: Zero-loss sensing with magnetic induction sensors is designed to capture every turn accurately and durably.
Built for long sessions: A lightweight 72g build and compact 56mm size keep the cube quick and manageable in hand.
72 tuning configurations: Gives you a wide adjustment range to better match your preferred feel.
